scenarios.scenario: Reverse the template name order in grouped Details view

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below
its English folder contains the standard inch part template

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the user selects the standard inch part in the English folder
the user switches to the metric folder and displays grouped Details view
the previously selected standard inch part is displayed in the details pane
the visible part section lists two Sheet Metal entries before two Standard entries
the user clicks the Name column header
the visible part section lists the Standard entries before the Sheet Metal entries
the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units
the user clicks the Name column header again
the visible part section lists the Sheet Metal entries before the Standard entries
the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units
the user restores Medium icons and cancels the chooser
the chooser closes and the original part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Navigate adjacent part templates with arrow keys

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below
its English folder contains the standard inch part template

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the new-document chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the part group displays Sheet Metal (mm) immediately before Standard (DIN)
the user selects the Sheet Metal (mm) part template
its tile is selected and its details identify millimeter units
the user presses Right
the Standard (DIN) part tile is selected
the details identify Standard (DIN) and millimeter units
the user presses Left
the Sheet Metal (mm) part tile is selected again
its sheet-metal details are displayed
the user presses Down
the template gallery scrolls down
Sheet Metal (mm) remains selected with its details displayed
the user presses Escape
the chooser closes and the original part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Use horizontal arrows at Part template group boundaries

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below
its English folder contains the standard inch part template

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the user sizes the chooser so the gallery has a horizontal scrollbar and moves it to its leftmost position
the Part group begins with Sheet Metal (DIN) and ends with Standard (mm)
the user selects Standard (mm) and presses Right
Standard (mm) remains selected and identified in the details pane
the gallery scroll position advances within the Part group
the user presses Left
Standard (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane
the user presses Home and then Left
Sheet Metal (DIN) remains selected and identified in the details pane
the gallery returns to its leftmost horizontal position
the user presses Escape
the chooser closes and the original part remains active
